verdict.rationale: Ramp's own MCP server lets users connect ChatGPT, Claude and similar assistants to query Ramp data and take actions in natural language, with role-based admin controls. The docs also note a gap: bill approvals aren't yet available via MCP, so natural-language operation does not cover every workflow. Missing for 10: bill approvals via natural language, a native in-product natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ramp MCP allows you to securely connect Ramp with AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, so you can query Ramp data and take actions with natural language.
Approve or reject transactions, reimbursements, and unified requests (purchase orders, fund requests, procurement approvals)
